points.title: 早年成长
points.description: 恩格斯出生于巴门一个富裕的纺织工厂主家庭。他的父亲是一位虔诚的新教徒，保守且注重商业利益。恩格斯接受了良好的教育，但与父亲的思想存在明显分歧。少年时期，他开始接触黑格尔哲学，并逐渐发展出激进的政治观点。这段家庭环境塑造了他对资本主义社会的批判意识，也为他后来与马克思的合作奠定了思想基础。
points.descriptionEn: Engels was born in Barmen to a wealthy textile manufacturing family. His father was a devout Protestant, conservative, and focused on business interests. Engels received a good education but had clear ideological differences with his father. During his youth, he began to study Hegelian philosophy and gradually developed radical political views. This family environment shaped his critical consciousness of capitalist society and laid the ideological foundation for his later collaboration with Marx.

points.title: 新闻工作与思想形成
points.description: 1842年，恩格斯被父亲派往曼海姆的一家纺织公司工作，但他将更多时间投入新闻写作。他为《莱茵报》撰稿，并开始研究英国工人阶级状况。在此期间，他撰写了《英国工人阶级状况》，这是第一部系统研究工人阶级状况的著作。恩格斯的思想逐渐从民主主义转向共产主义，并首次与马克思在巴黎会面，两人建立了深厚的友谊和思想合作关系。
points.descriptionEn: In 1842, Engels was sent to Mannheim by his father to work in a textile company, but he devoted more time to journalism. He contributed to the Rheinische Zeitung and began studying the condition of the British working class. During this period, he wrote 'The Condition of the Working Class in England,' the first systematic study of the working class. Engels' ideology gradually shifted from democracy to communism, and he met Marx for the first time in Paris, establishing a deep friendship and intellectual partnership.

points.title: 与马克思合作
points.description: 1845年，恩格斯移居布鲁塞尔，与马克思共同开展革命活动。他们合写了《德意志意识形态》，首次系统阐述了历史唯物主义理论。1848年，两人共同起草了《共产党宣言》，这是国际共产主义运动的纲领性文件。在布鲁塞尔期间，恩格斯积极参与革命组织工作，并帮助马克思建立了共产主义者同盟。这一时期是两人思想合作最紧密的阶段，共同奠定了马克思主义的理论基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1845, Engels moved to Brussels and engaged in revolutionary activities with Marx. They co-authored 'The German Ideology,' which first systematically expounded the theory of historical materialism. In 1848, they jointly drafted 'The Communist Manifesto,' the programmatic document of the international communist movement. During their time in Brussels, Engels actively participated in revolutionary organizations and helped Marx establish the Communist League. This period marked the closest phase of their intellectual cooperation, jointly laying the theoretical foundation of Marxism.

points.title: 商业实践与理论研究
points.description: 1850年，恩格斯回到曼彻斯特，在他父亲的公司工作长达20年。这段看似矛盾的经历使他能够深入观察资本主义经济运行，同时为马克思提供经济支持。在曼彻斯特期间，恩格斯继续理论研究，撰写了《反杜林论》等重要著作，并协助马克思整理《资本论》第二、三卷。他通过商业实践积累了丰富的经济知识，这使他的理论分析更加贴近现实，为马克思主义经济学的发展做出了重要贡献。
points.descriptionEn: In 1850, Engels returned to Manchester and worked in his father's company for 20 years. This seemingly contradictory experience allowed him to observe the operation of capitalist economy firsthand while providing financial support to Marx. During his time in Manchester, Engels continued theoretical research, writing important works like 'Anti-Dühring' and assisting Marx in editing the second and third volumes of 'Capital.' Through his business practice, he accumulated extensive economic knowledge, making his theoretical analysis more grounded in reality and making significant contributions to the development of Marxist economics.

points.title: 晚年领导与国际影响
points.description: 1870年，恩格斯移居伦敦，完全投身于理论研究和革命活动。马克思去世后，他成为国际工人运动的领袖和精神导师。恩格斯整理出版了《资本论》第二、三卷，并撰写了《家庭、私有制和国家的起源》等重要著作。他在伦敦指导第二国际的建立，支持各国社会主义政党的发展，同时与各种机会主义思潮进行斗争。恩格斯晚年还关注俄国革命，对东方社会发展道路提出了重要见解，极大地扩展了马克思主义的理论视野。
points.descriptionEn: In 1870, Engels moved to London and devoted himself entirely to theoretical research and revolutionary activities. After Marx's death, he became the leader and spiritual guide of the international workers' movement. Engels edited and published the second and third volumes of 'Capital' and wrote important works like 'The Origin of the Family, Private Property and the State.' In London, he guided the establishment of the Second International, supported the development of socialist parties in various countries, and struggled against various opportunist tendencies. In his later years, Engels also paid attention to the Russian Revolution and put forward important views on the development path of Eastern societies, greatly expanding the theoretical horizon of Marxism.

points.title: 逝世与遗产
points.description: 1895年8月5日，恩格斯在伦敦逝世，享年74岁。他的葬礼简单而庄重，只有几位亲近的朋友参加。恩格斯一生留下了丰富的理论遗产，包括与马克思合著的《共产党宣言》、独立撰写的《反杜林论》、《家庭、私有制和国家的起源》等著作。他不仅是马克思主义的共同创始人，也是马克思思想的忠实阐释者和捍卫者。恩格斯的思想对20世纪世界社会主义运动产生了深远影响，至今仍是研究资本主义和社会主义的重要理论资源。
points.descriptionEn: On August 5, 1895, Engels died in London at the age of 74. His funeral was simple and solemn, attended only by a few close friends. Engels left behind a rich theoretical legacy, including co-authored works with Marx such as 'The Communist Manifesto' and independently written works like 'Anti-Dühring' and 'The Origin of the Family, Private Property and the State.' He was not only a co-founder of Marxism but also a faithful interpreter and defender of Marx's ideas. Engels' thought had a profound impact on the world socialist movement of the 20th century and remains an important theoretical resource for the study of capitalism and socialism.

supporter.zh: 恩格斯被视为马克思主义的共同创始人，是科学社会主义理论的重要奠基者。他不仅与马克思共同创立了历史唯物主义和辩证唯物主义，还独立发展了马克思主义的多个领域，特别是军事理论和自然科学哲学。恩格斯对马克思的长期经济支持使他能够完成《资本论》的创作，这种无私的友谊和合作精神成为知识分子的典范。他的著作如《反杜林论》和《家庭、私有制和国家的起源》至今仍是马克思主义理论的重要组成部分，为世界社会主义运动提供了坚实的理论基础。
supporter.en: Engels is regarded as a co-founder of Marxism and a key founder of scientific socialist theory. He not only co-created historical materialism and dialectical materialism with Marx but also independently developed various aspects of Marxist theory, particularly in military theory and the philosophy of natural sciences. Engels' long-term financial support for Marx enabled him to complete 'Capital,' and this selfless friendship and cooperation have become a model for intellectuals. His works such as 'Anti-Dühring' and 'The Origin of the Family, Private Property and the State' remain essential components of Marxist theory, providing a solid theoretical foundation for the world socialist movement.

critic.zh: 批评者认为恩格斯对马克思主义的发展存在局限性，特别是在晚年对资本主义适应性的低估。他未能预见垄断资本主义的形成，也未充分认识到工人阶级内部的结构性分化。此外，恩格斯在整理出版《资本论》第二、三卷时，对马克思手稿的编辑和修改引发了争议，一些学者认为这改变了马克思的原意。批评者还指出，恩格斯晚年对暴力革命的态度有所软化，被一些人视为对革命原则的妥协，这影响了后来马克思主义的发展方向。
critic.en: Critics argue that Engels' development of Marxism had limitations, particularly his underestimation of capitalism's adaptability in his later years. He failed to anticipate the emergence of monopoly capitalism and did not fully recognize the structural divisions within the working class. Additionally, Engels' editing and revision of Marx's manuscripts when publishing the second and third volumes of 'Capital' have been controversial, with some scholars believing this altered Marx's original intentions. Critics also note that Engels softened his attitude toward violent revolution in his later years, seen by some as a compromise on revolutionary principles, which influenced the subsequent development of Marxism.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，恩格斯被视为一位复杂而多面的思想家，既是马克思的亲密战友，也是独立的理论家。他的思想经历了从民主主义到共产主义的演变，这一过程反映了19世纪欧洲激进思想的发展脉络。恩格斯在马克思主义理论体系中的地位独特，他既是理论的共同创立者，又是马克思思想的阐释者和传播者。在流行文化中，恩格斯常与马克思并提，作为共产主义运动的象征性人物。然而，近年来学术界越来越重视恩格斯的独立贡献，特别是他在自然科学、人类学和军事理论方面的研究，这些方面常被传统叙事所忽视。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Engels is viewed as a complex and multifaceted thinker—both Marx's close comrade and an independent theorist. His intellectual evolution from democracy to communism reflects the development of radical European thought in the 19th century. Engels holds a unique position in Marxist theory as both a co-founder of the theory and an interpreter and disseminator of Marx's ideas. In popular culture, Engels is often mentioned alongside Marx as a symbolic figure of the communist movement. However, in recent years, academia has increasingly recognized Engels' independent contributions, particularly his research in natural sciences, anthropology, and military theory, aspects often overlooked in traditional narratives.

self.zh: 历史不过是追求着自己目的的人的活动而已。
self.en: History is nothing but the activity of men in pursuit of their ends.

others.zh: 恩格斯是马克思的第二个自我，没有他，马克思可能永远无法完成《资本论》，而马克思主义也永远不会达到它所达到的完善程度。
others.en: Engels was Marx's second self; without him, Marx might never have completed 'Capital,' and Marxism would never have reached the degree of perfection it attained.
